subject_line: Why your husband's losing weight faster than you
opening: Hey, happy Sunday. This week we've got answers to the question that's quietly driving a lot of you a little bit crazy, plus a flank steak trick that'll save you money without sacrificing a single bite. Grab your coffee. Let's get into it.

hero.title: Why Your Husband Loses Weight Faster Than You
hero.teaser: You're eating the exact same meals. You both started on the same day. And somehow he's down 15 pounds while you're staring at a scale that barely budged. It feels unfair, and honestly, it is. But here's the thing: the reason has nothing to do with your effort, your willpower, or whether you're doing carnivore right. Chloe breaks down what's actually going on, and what it means for how you should measure your own progress.
hero.cta: Read before you weigh in again

supporting.title: How to Cook Flank Steak So It Isn't Tough
supporting.teaser: There's one slicing mistake almost everyone makes with flank steak, and Marcus says fixing it changes everything about how the meat eats.

supporting.title: Why Carbs Wreck Your Stomach After Carnivore
supporting.teaser: Your gut was perfect for weeks, then one birthday dinner left you flattened, and Sarah explains exactly why your body reacted the way it did.

supporting.title: Carnivore Dinners for Nights You Can't Face Cooking
supporting.teaser: Chloe rounded up the lazy dinners that keep you on track when it's 7pm and you've got nothing left in the tank.

try_this_week: Swap your measuring tape for the scale this week. If you're not seeing the number move the way you expected, grab a tape measure and check your waist, hips, and arms instead. Community members report that body measurements often tell a completely different story than the scale does, especially in the first few months.
looking_ahead: Next week we're getting into something a lot of you have asked about: what actually happens to your hormones on carnivore, and whether the changes are working for you or against you.
